basic_details.job_title: District Court, Jayashankar Bhupalpally Typist Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: One post of Typist is to be filled on a one-year contract, at a consolidated pay of Rs.19,500/- per month, in the Fast Track Special Court for Expeditious Trial and Disposal of Rape and POCSO Act Cases, Jayashankar Bhupalpally. District and Sessions Judge, Jayashankar Bhupalpally, by Speed Post or courier, and must be received by 5.00 PM on 28 November 2026; applications received after that time will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: About Jayashankar Bhupalpally District Court Typist
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Office of the Principal District and Sessions Court, Jayashankar Bhupalpally, in Telangana. The Typist will work in the Fast Track Special Court for Expeditious Trial and Disposal of Rape and POCSO Act Cases, Jayashankar Bhupalpally, set up as per G.O.Ms.No.104, Finance (HRM - II) Department, dated 30.12.2019. A copy of the notification has been submitted to the Registrar General, High Court for the State of Telangana, Hyderabad.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must be made in the format printed with the notification (page 4, "Application for the Post of Typist"), with a recent photograph affixed in the box provided. The form asks for full name, father's / husband's name, date of birth, age as on 01.11.2026, caste / category, sex, nationality, religion, educational qualifications (academic, technical, other), previous experience if any, local / non-local status, permanent address, address for correspondence and mobile number, followed by a signed declaration with station and date. Fill in the application form given with the notification and affix a recent photograph. Attach attested copies of the documents listed under Enclosures below, including a self-addressed registered post cover. Put the application in a sealed cover addressed to: The Honourable Prl. District and Sessions Judge, Jayashankar Bhupalpally. Send the cover by Speed Post or courier. Application forms will not be entertained either directly or in person. Make sure it reaches the office by 5.00 PM on 28 November 2026; applications received after that time will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The pay is on a contract basis; the notice states that remuneration shall be paid as fixed by the Government from time to time. Educational qualification (as per TJMSS Rules, 2018): Must have passed a Bachelor's Degree of any recognized University in India established or incorporated by or under a Central Act, State Act or Provincial Act, or an Institution recognized by the University Grants Commission, or any equivalent qualification. Must have passed the Telangana Government Technical Examination in English Typewriting by Higher Grade (45 WPM) or its equivalent examination. If a Higher Grade English Typewriting candidate is not available, English Typewriting Lower (30 WPM) will be considered. Must have knowledge or qualification in computer operation. Age limit: as on 01/11/2026, a candidate must have completed the age of 18 years and must not have completed the age of 34 years. Age relaxation (on the maximum age limit): SCs / STs / BCs / EWS: 5 years Physically Disabled candidates: 10 years Other eligibility conditions: Only eligible candidates of Jayashankar Bhupalpally District may apply. Only persons of sound health and active habits will be considered. Only persons with a proven record of ability, good performance and integrity will be considered. Persons who have been awarded any punishment for misconduct in disciplinary proceedings while in service are not eligible for consideration. Candidates should check the official notification for the complete eligibility wording for the Typist post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Attested copies of the following documents must be enclosed with the application: Certificates of academic qualifications such as marks lists, pass certificate, provisional certificate, testimonials, and other certificates to prove technical efficiency, if any Date of Birth Certificate Community Certificate in the case of SCs/STs/BCs, issued by the competent authority Employment Registration Card Certificate in respect of Local / Non-Local candidature in terms of the Presidential Order, 1975 A self-addressed registered post cover with acknowledgement worth Rs.70/-, or as fixed by the Postal Department for RPAD

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for the Typist post is in two stages: Typewriting test: a test in typewriting with regard to technical efficiency for the post of Typist. Oral interview: candidates who qualify in the typewriting test will be called for an oral interview. The notice does not mention the date or venue of the typewriting test or interview. No TA and DA will be paid for the journey performed in connection with the appointment.

content_sections.heading: Terms of Appointment
content_sections.text: The candidate will be appointed only on a contract basis as per Rule 9 of the Telangana State and Subordinate Service Rules, 1996, for a period of ONE YEAR. A Deed of agreement must be executed at the time of appointment. Selected persons have to produce a physical fitness certificate and enter into an agreement / contract with the District Court, Jayashankar Bhupalpally on such terms and conditions as the appointing authority deems fit. The contract appointment automatically ceases to be in operation unless a fresh proposal is made and a fresh contract is entered into. In the case of retired employees, the provisions of the Telangana Civil Service (Conduct) Rules, 1964 and the Telangana Pension Code shall be applicable mutatis mutandis. No other service rules shall be applicable other than those above.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications with insufficient information will be summarily rejected. Applications received after the stipulated date and time will not be accepted. No correspondence will be entertained in any respect. Candidates resorting to bring influence of any kind will be disqualified summarily. The notification is available on the website https://bhupalapally.dcourts.gov.in .

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Jayashankar Bhupalpally District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 Typist post, in the Fast Track Special Court for Expeditious Trial and Disposal of Rape and POCSO Act Cases, Jayashankar Bhupalpally.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Bhupalpally District Court Typist post?
faq.answer: Applications must be received by 5.00 PM on 28 November 2026; applications received after that time will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the Typist post?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's Degree from a recognised university or equivalent, a pass in the Telangana Government Technical Examination in English Typewriting Higher Grade (45 WPM) or equivalent (Lower Grade 30 WPM is considered if no Higher Grade candidate is available), and knowledge or qualification in computer operation.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Typist post?
faq.answer: As on 01/11/2026, a candidate must have completed 18 years and must not have completed 34 years. SCs/STs/BCs/EWS get 5 years and Physically Disabled candidates get 10 years of relaxation in the maximum age.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the Bhupalpally District Court Typist?
faq.answer: The consolidated amount is Rs.19,500/- per month on a contract basis; remuneration shall be paid as fixed by the Government from time to time.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the Typist post?
faq.answer: Send the application in the prescribed format, with attested documents, in a sealed cover addressed to the Honourable Prl. District and Sessions Judge, Jayashankar Bhupalpally, by Speed Post or courier. Applications are not entertained directly or in person.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Typist post?
faq.answer: There will be a typewriting test on technical efficiency, and candidates who qualify will be called for an oral interview.

faq.question: Q8. Who can apply for this Typist recruitment?
faq.answer: Only eligible candidates of Jayashankar Bhupalpally District can apply.

faq.question: Q9. Is the Bhupalpally District Court Typist job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is on a contract basis under Rule 9 of the Telangana State and Subordinate Service Rules, 1996, for a period of one year, on executing a Deed of agreement.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA or DA be paid for attending the test or interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA and DA will be paid for the journey performed in connection with the appointment.
